q1_issues.issue: "The Stilllight Lantern was lit that night" is parsed as an adjectival state (reified lit state plus flat copular atom), but a predicative participle is a verb by the instruction set's own test ("the worktop was laminated" IS a verb), so this should be the agentless passive of light.

(LocatedIn sk_water_1 sunken_cove) reads the of-genitive "the water of the Sunken Cove" as containment; LocatedIn is licensed only for a stated in/at/inside/within, and a relational of-phrase takes the ordinary genitive PartOf / Possession.

The non-veridical before-clause is asserted as fact - the reach event plus (Past sk_reach_1) at full strength claims the shape did reach the lantern, which "turned away before the shape reached the Stilllight Lantern" denies.
The log event carries no role atom for its direct object "the report" - the object surfaces only inside the sealed Theme term.

The "as a possible wraith near-miss" predicate is sealed as a Theme term, but sealing is licensed only for finite clausal complements of attitude verbs, embedded questions, imperatives and counterfactuals - not for a secondary predicate on an object.
The continuation copular "stay alert" drops "stay": the state is reified with the controller as Experiencer but no (Still sk_alert_1) tag records the continuation the verb states.

The matrix predicate "followed" is unrepresented - the strength-0 bundle denies a seeing event instead - and the noun "sighting" is re-lemmatized to the derived verb see, which the inflection-only (never derivation) rule bars.

The explicit quantifier "no" gets no (QuantifierPhrase ...) companion, which the negation rules make mandatory for every explicit quantifier word so that quantifier-none stays distinct from plain not-negation.

q2_gaps: non-veridical "before"-clause ("turned away before it reached X") - the Before relation parses both clauses as asserted eventualities, with no licensed way to record that the later one did not occur
classificatory secondary predicate "log / record / classify X as Y", with a "possible" hedge - no licensed encoding for a non-veridical as-phrase on an object
notes: Time-term propagation ("that night", and "the next afternoon" as Day 496 plus Before), the compound decompositions with noun modifiers correctly unexposed, the plural-modifier distribution rules, and the s12 attitude seal with its projected definite typing and in-seal past perfect all follow the instruction set.
